title: Adapting Neural Posterior Estimators for Simulation-Based Inference in Agent-Based Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.07413v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agent-based models (ABMs) are widely used in economics and social sciences. They represent heterogeneous personal behaviors and their interactions by using simulations, whereas their likelihoods are often intractable for parameter estimations. Therefore, most traditional statistical inference techniques are hindered. Driven by recent advances in probabilistic machine learning, recent works have applied neural networks to achieve likelihood-free inference in large-scale ABMs. Specifically, Neural Posterior Estimation using normalizing flows provide amortized Bayesian inference from simulations, yet a pre-trained estimator may become inaccurate when the target task changes. In this work, we investigate the practicality of adapting a pre-trained conditional normalizing flow through a unified sequential neural posterior estimation test-time training (SNPE-TTT) framework. translated_title: 面向基于智能体模型的模拟推断的神经后验估计器自适应方法
translated_abstract: 基于智能体的模型（ABM）在经济学和社会科学中被广泛使用。这类模型通过模拟来刻画异质性的个体行为及其相互作用，但其似然函数往往难以求解，导致参数估计困难，从而阻碍了大多数传统统计推断技术的应用。在概率机器学习最新进展的推动下，近期研究已将神经网络应用于大规模ABM中以实现无似然推断。具体而言，基于归一化流的神经后验估计（NPE）可以从模拟中获得摊销式贝叶斯推断，然而当目标任务发生变化时，预训练的估计器可能变得不准确。在本工作中，我们通过一个统一的序贯神经后验估计-测试时训练（SNPE-TTT）框架，研究了自适应调整预训练条件归一化流的实用性。该框架包含四种自适应策略：全参数微调……
tldr: 本文提出统一的SNPE-TTT框架，通过测试时训练对预训练的条件归一化流神经后验估计器进行自适应调整，从而解决基于智能体模型中目标任务变化导致推断失效的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified SNPE-TTT framework that adapts pre-trained conditional normalizing flow neural posterior estimators via test-time training, addressing inaccurate inference when target tasks change in agent-based models.
